tools.name: bar_model_capabilities
tools.description: Read supported bar-model content, versions, limits, presentation and revision operations before creating a resource.

tools.name: create_bar_model
tools.description: Create editable Bar modelling resources. Supply spec OR exact envelope, never both. spec:{example?:BM01..BM09|H07|H18|source-sharing,worked?:false,bars?,spans?,presentation?}; example and custom bars/spans are mutually exclusive. Omit for BM01 unworked sharing64 in3:5. bars:[{id,name:{text,state},offset:numeric-string,parts:[{id,weight:positive-numeric-string,label:{text,state},shade:boolean}]}]. spans:[{id,from:{barId,partId,edge:start|end},to:{barId,partId,edge},label:{text,state},side:above|below,style:brace|dimension}]. Labels state:value|blank|question|line|hidden; hidden retains text. Shared presentation:{unitMm:4..16,barHeightMm:8..16,fontPt:10..14,nameWidthMm:20..60}. Up to6bars,24parts/bar,96parts,18spans,32KiB. Exact geometry fractions/decimals,algebra labels never evaluated. Whole/share/difference braces anchor actual boundaries. No automatic calculation. Returns canonical envelope/hash,preview,SVG,600ppiPNG,JSON,versions,native size,print facts,bounded editor link and warnings. Editable files/links retain hidden answers; pupil output default.

tools.name: revise_bar_model
tools.description: Revise exact bar-model envelope with baseHash=contentHash and operations(max30,atomic). set_label {target:{barId,partId?}|{spanId},label:{text,state}}; set_part {barId,partId,weight?,shade?}; add_bar {bar,afterId?}; remove_bar {barId,discardSpans?:false}; add_part {barId,part,afterId?}; remove_part {barId,partId,discardSpans?:false}; add_span {span}; set_span {span} replaces exact identified span; remove_span {spanId}; set_alignment {barId,offset}; set_print {presentation:{unitMm?,barHeightMm?,fontPt?,nameWidthMm?}}; reveal_saved_answers {} only on explicit request. Use complete bar/part/span schemas from create_bar_model and stable returned IDs. Removal of referenced parts/bars requires discardSpans:true or prior explicit span removal; never reanchors. Label state changes preserve supplied saved text. No implicit maths, answer reveal or resizing from labels. Empty operations refresh files/links. Returns envelope/hash,preview,SVG,verified600ppiPNG,JSON,native dimensions,versions,print facts and warnings; editable files/links retain hidden answers.
